facts.quote: Tenor of consumption loans in the nature of bullet repayment loans shall be capped at 12 months, which may be renewed in terms of paragraph 11.
facts.text: The Reserve Bank of India caps the tenure of consumption-oriented bullet repayment gold loans at 12 months.

facts.label: official
facts.quote: However, detailed credit assessment, including assessment of borrower's repayment capacity shall be undertaken in case the total loan amount against eligible collateral is above ₹2.5 lakh to a borrower.
facts.text: RBI directions require lenders to conduct a detailed credit assessment of borrower repayment capacity whenever loans against gold collateral exceed 2.5 lakh rupees.

facts.label: official
facts.quote: An NBFC shall release or return the pledged eligible collateral held as security to the borrower(s)/ legal heir(s) on the same day but in any case, not exceeding a maximum period of seven working days upon full repayment or settlement of the loan.
facts.text: Upon full loan repayment or settlement, lenders are required by RBI regulations to release pledged collateral within a maximum period of seven working days.

facts.label: official
facts.quote: An NBFC shall implement a transparent auction procedure, which shall include, inter alia, announcement of the auction to the public by issue of advertisements in at least two newspapers, one in the regional language and another in a national daily.
facts.text: In the event of a borrower default leading to auction of pledged gold, lenders must publish public advertisements in at least two newspapers.

scenes.vo: Isliye loan band karte waqt likhwa lijiye ki kis tareekh ko zevar milega. 7 kaam ke din ki seema yaad rakhiye. Yeh aapka haq hai.

visual.prompt: Photorealistic view of a quiet Indian residential lane at sunrise, a bank branch shutter rising in the distance, birds on wires, clean road in the lower part.

scenes.vo: Toh shuru wala sawaal: kam byaaj wala hamesha sasta nahi. Agli video mein, credit score kaise banta hai aur kaise girta hai. Yeh video us dost ko bhejiye jo sirf rate dekh kar loan leta hai.

visual.prompt: Photorealistic still life of gold bangles and a salary envelope side by side on a wooden table by a window at golden hour, plain table surface below.

scenes.vo: Aur aap? Mushkil waqt mein kya karenge, zevar girvi ya salary par loan? Comments mein likhiye.

thumbnail.scene: LEFT: a family's old gold bangles shining on a red velvet tray at a bank loan counter; RIGHT: the same bangles on a bare table in a crowded auction hall under a single harsh light.

script.title: 2 lakh ka udhaar: zevar girvi ya personal loan?

hooks: Gold loan sasta kyun hota hai?
Kisht chhooti toh zevar kab neelam hota hai?
2 lakh ek saal ke liye: kaun sa loan kitne ka padega?
topic.summary: Gold loan against personal loan for a sudden need: interest, processing fees, repayment styles, what happens on default (auction against a hit to the credit score), and the RBI limits on how much is lent against gold. A worked example of two lakh for one year.
